About these 18 rides

There’s a ride every day of the week; Saturday has the most, with 6. The earliest start is Danny’s Cycles Scarsdale Sunday Road Ride at 9:30 am; the latest is Rochester Bike Gang Thursday Ride at 7:30 pm. After work, 13 roll on a weekday evening. Beginners are welcome on 10 of them. There’s one ride made for LGBTQ+ riders, 1 for women, trans and femme riders, 2 for families and 2 for adaptive riders. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 18 and Nov 9, 2026.
